description:
In this video, we test out official SteamOS running on the brand new MSI Claw 8 AI+. Valve recently released SteamOS beta 3.8.7, which officially adds controller support and SD card reliability improvements for MSI Claw handhelds. We updated this device, which is powered by the Intel Core Ultra 7 258V Lunar Lake CPU and 32GB of RAM, to the main branch (version 3.9) to see exactly how it handles PC gaming on Linux.
